entities.summary: Waldemar José Rial Ferrari was a Uruguayan basketball player who competed in the 1960 Summer Olympics and in the 1964 Summer Olympics. He was born in Paso de los Toros, Tacuarembó Department. He twice presided over Club Atlético Goes.
